Jab chaadar-e-aaftaab ko lapet diya jaaega
Jab taare gir padenge
Jab pahaad harkat mein aa jaayenge
Jab anqareeb janne waali oontniyaan mu'attal kar di jaayengi
Jab jaanwaron ko ikattha kiya jaaega
Jab darya bhadak uthenge
Jab roohon ko jismon se jod diya jaaega
Aur jab zinda dar-gor ladkiyon ke baare mein sawaal kiya jaaega
Ke unhein kis gunaah mein maara gaya hai
Aur jab naama-e-aamaal muntashir kar diye jaayenge
Aur jab aasmaan ka chhilka utaar diya jaaega
Aur jab Jahannam ki aag bhadka di jaaegi
Aur jab Jannat qareeb-tar kar di jaaegi
Tab har nafs ko maaloom hoga ke us ne kya haazir kiya hai
To main un sitaaron ki qasam khaata hoon jo palat jaane waale hain
Chalne waale aur chhup jaane waale hain
Aur raat ki qasam jab khatm hone ko aaye
Aur subah ki qasam jab saans lene lage
Beshak yeh ek mu'azzaz farishte ka bayaan hai
Woh saahib-e-quwwat hai aur Saahib-e-Arsh ki baargaah ka makeen hai
Woh wahaan qaabil-e-itaa'at aur phir amaanat-daar hai
Aur tumhaara saathi Paighambar deewaana nahin hai
Aur us ne farishte ko buland ufuq par dekha hai
Aur woh ghaib ke baare mein bakheel nahin hai
Aur yeh Quran kisi Shaitaan-e-Rajeem ka qaul nahin hai
To tum kidhar chale ja rahe ho
Yeh sirf aalameen ke liye ek naseehat ka saamaan hai
Jo tum mein se seedha hona chaahe
Aur tum log kuch nahin chaah sakte magar yeh ke aalameen ka Parwardigar Khuda chaahe
